flags.why: The elder or veteran statesman meaning is more likely today than the ancient Roman senator meaning ([definition](https://www.vjol.info/nguyen-lao-la-gi)).

The small-boat meaning is regional vocabulary associated with Huế and needs a Central tag ([Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf)).

This joking address is widely used among forum participants regardless of sexual orientation, so defining it by gay identity teaches a false association ([forum discussion](https://voz.vn/t/thac-mac-ve-cach-xung-ho-tren-voz.43337/page-4)).
flags.fix: humorous, familiar form of address to another person, especially on Internet forums
